quest.title: Blooming Sands
quest.description: Raef from Aaru Village seems to be troubled by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Agh, there's just no time at all...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: And no one will swap shifts with me, either. What do I do now...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Eh? Traveler? Um... Traveler, please hold on a moment!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: I'm sorry for taking up your time, but I'd like to ask you if you're free... and if you could do me a favor...

choices.text: Well, let's hear your story, then...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: You'd help me! Thank you! Thank you so much!

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Here's the situation: I ordered a flower pot from Azalai's shop, alongside a batch of seeds.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Originally, I had asked a friend to help me get them...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: But he suddenly told me that he had a mission to attend to and wouldn't have time to help me out. There was too little time for me to find someone else...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: So Traveler, could you please help me collect my purchases from Azalai's? I hear that he should be at the entrance to the village right now, waiting for goods to come in.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you buy all this stuff for, anyway?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: They're for my girlfriend, Nermin.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: She's in poor health, so she's been convalescing at home.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I mean, you've seen it too. Aaru Village is in the middle of the desert, so there's not much greenery to go around. Can't say this is the best environment, can you?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: So I bought some plants to place in her house, but always staying in her room has kept her in a bad mood.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I'm also very busy at work, so I basically can't go to see her in the day. We only have time to talk to each other at night...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: That's why I thought that perhaps I could get her to raise some flowers herself, if only just to help pass the time and take her mind off her illness.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I didn't expect things to get complicated like this...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Thank you so much! Just bring them straight back to me once you get them.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I need to sow those seeds, loosen the soil, apply some fertilizer...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: But Nermin's constitution isn't that great. Will all this work just tire her out...?

choices.text: If you've got the pay, I've got the time.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Eh? Well... I do have some savings, so you don't have to worry about that...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: But either way, thank you so much for agreeing to help.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Huh, so there was another batch after all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey, about Raef's goods...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean the stuff he ordered from me? Well, you're in luck! The batch of goods I just received has his stuff in there.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: I must say, though, that he ordered quite a lot of things. Are you here to pick up his order?

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Well, apart from that pot, he's also ordered various seeds, fertilizer, and other items used in gardening...

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: They're pretty weighty when put together. Are you sure you'll be fine by yourself?

response.speaker: Azalai
response.text: Ah, is that so... Well, that's fine. I'll just get all this stuff wrapped up for you. Thanks for making the trip, by the way...

choices.text: I did agree to help, so...

talks.objective: Bring the stuff back to Raef

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Traveler! Have you brought the stuff?

talks.objective: Bring the stuff back to Raef

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: These are the ones. Thank you so much, Traveler.

choices.text: Sure you're not trying to open your own flower shop?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Uh, well, I... I just wanted to buy more at once to save myself some extra trips, you know?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Anyway, go rest over there for a while. I need to sow these seeds and put some fertilizer in and...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Raef starts working on the flower pot...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Alright, this should do it! All Nermin needs to do is water this plant.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Traveler, could I, ah, trouble you to help me bring this flower pot to her?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why don't you go yourself?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I need to guard this path. If any foodstuffs or goods pass through, I'll need to get more people from the village to come take them.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: And you know how it is around here. If we're too slow, the goods are going to spoil under the sun.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Just do me this favor, please. Nermin's not far from here. All you have to do is give this pot of flowers to her. I'll find a way to bring the rest to her.

choices.text: What do you need so much stuff for!?

talks.objective: Bring the flower pot to Nermin

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Someone inside hears movement...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Hello. May I help you with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'm here to give you this flower pot.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Huh... Is this from Raef?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: There are flowers in this pot? Really? Thank you for helping him send this to me. I like it very much...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: But... Can I really raise these flowers properly?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it your first time growing flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Well, no. I'm just... not very good at taking care of plants. The previous ones all withered in my hands...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: I imagine that this pot of flowers must be even more delicate still. If I were to fail to care for it properly again...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Ugh, no, no, I can't just... Since the flowers are already in my hands, I must take good care of it!

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Perhaps Granny Kulsoom knows how to solve this problem...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: You're back, Traveler. Thank you so much for helping out... How is Nermin doing?

choices.text: She's worried that she won't be able to take care of the flowers.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Well... I'll help her look into this. If all else fails, we'll find someone to ask about it.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: And if even that fails... I'll just... look for something that's easy to grow and keep alive, I guess.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Well, in any case, thanks for helping me out, Traveler. Please, take this as your reward.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I'll send the other items to her later.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Wait a moment. Did these gardening tools not come with instruction manuals? ...Oh no. I have no idea how to use them!

choices.text: Have you never sent her flowers before?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Well, I wouldn't say that exactly, but the ones I would ask people to help me buy for her were already fully-grown. By the time they arrived in the village, they were nearly all dried out...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: That's why I decided that I would send her a freshly planted pot of flowers this time.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: I do hope that Nermin can get better soon...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Strange, where's that other batch of goods?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: I... Did I buy too many things...?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: If these flowers needs to be watered every day, just how much water will I need by the end?
